TRUE DRIVER: the lens must hold the focus card WHOLE with its source line and the docked old value; with 45- and 44-character source values the focus card is very tall, so at 1:1 the lens window falls under 0.37 of the short side. Tried before capping (text 22.5 down to 16.4 px): text column and bands, room width with narrower card wrapping, lower questioner and table, the crop taking whole neighbour cards and more floor, a stacked dock.
